name: atmosphere-tool
summary: Atmosphere Tool Native 2.4.0 for Hytale 0.7.4: global fog, brightness, independent moon transparency/size, native sky path, night lighting and global custom saves. Zones, global Fullbright and client-volume fog are archived. 2.3.1 visuals accepted by user; 2.4.0 runtime/rollback tests pass, final three-tab client check pending. Submission package prepared; no marketplace upload.
technologies: Hytale Weather and UI/item asset APIs
constraints: Canonical workspace G:/Zytale; never create project files under the old Desktop/Zytale location.
Do not use computer-use/GUI automation for this project.
No client DLL, renderer patch, shaders or game bytes in the native release.
English UI and documentation. All Rights Reserved, selected by owner 2026-10-29.
Global-only Custom Atmosphere saves; preserve library v2, old IDs and archived data.
No marketplace upload or GitHub Release authorized; source/docs updates to Riiccardoo/Forge-Core are authorized.
Do not infer platform authorization, current-version compatibility, FPS or final UI acceptance from server tests.
decisions: The independent Moon transparency control supersedes density-driven lunar fading; it must work with maximum fog.
Sky angle/height moves the whole sky without modifying world simulation time; user accepted this behavior.
One Fog ON/OFF pair affects map fog and backdrop. Separate background controls were rejected.
Fog brightness uses common RGB gain within channel headroom, not whitening or emitted light.
Archive Zones code/UI/backend and retain files unread; never delete saved area definitions when retiring this feature.
Preserve the original client-volume renderer privately as technical history, not a publishable supported client component.
Native graduated Fullbright attempts failed to satisfy the global requirement; keep the implementation archived.
Prepare a single JAR for Mods/plugin upload; documentation/source ZIPs are separate handoff artifacts.

Direct reuse: approved native weather/sky/save implementation. Analogy: EXP-000014 release allowlist and evidence gates. New work: Zones backend removal, timer measurement, package audit and source sync.

validation.benchmark_limit: Three samples each, same host, empty v1 zone fixture, warm cache; baseline includes normal v1 backup; no total-load or FPS gain demonstrated.
